about.headline: Editor & Designer crafting scroll-stopping visuals since 2019.
about.bio: I'm a freelance video editor and graphic designer who helps creators, brands, and businesses turn raw footage and rough ideas into polished, high-converting content. My work blends rhythm-driven editing with clean, intentional design — built to hold attention in the first two seconds and hold up under a brand's scrutiny.

services.title: Video Editing
services.description: Long-form and short-form editing with pacing, sound design, and color that keeps viewers watching.

services.title: Motion Graphics
services.description: Custom animated titles, lower thirds, and kinetic typography that make your brand move.

services.title: Thumbnail Design
services.description: High-CTR thumbnails engineered around curiosity, contrast, and clarity.

services.title: Graphic Design
services.description: Posters, carousels, ads, and print-ready design with a consistent visual system.

services.title: Branding
